items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Ernest Rogers was one I know

ctx.x: Oh, we were talking about the Tulane band and we never did get down who was in that band, who the different members were.
Well, I can't tell you all of them either, but I can tell you some of them. Yeah, sure. Ernest Rogers was one I know, and Big Al Landry, and Happy Remus, that's Bill Matthews' brother.
